'''Kingston''' was a [[Color/Legends|black]] haired, fair skinned, and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Kingston had obtained the rank of [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] and was stationed inside the [[Thul Palace|palace]] of the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Great]] [[House of Thul]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], as the house had sided with the Empire and gained their support in the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. He specialized in melee combat, using a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] to fight, and wore red [[Armor/Legends|armor]] whilst deployed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Whilst Kingston studied maps in the palace, he was attacked by an individual aligned with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] him.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kingston first appeared as an enemy in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. Kingston is not involved in any quests in the game and is simply an elite enemy players of the Republic faction can choose to kill. This article assumes players killed him as part of 100% game completion.
